concerns.text: FR-010 mandates Phylogenetic Generalized Least Squares (PGLS) as a mandatory requirement. T023a implements OLS, Ridge, and Lasso but explicitly excludes PGLS. T024b implements 'fit_pgl' but is labeled as a regression placeholder in the Analyze report and lacks the explicit PGLS model fitting logic required by FR-010. No task explicitly implements the PGLS fitting step using the fetched tree.

FR-007 requires binarizing continuous physiological metrics (stomatal conductance/photosynthesis) into high/low classes. T027c and T027b only implement binarization/classification if an independent proxy exists. There is no task to implement the mandatory binarization of the physiological metrics (FR-007) when no proxy is found, which is required to enable the classification model (FR-008) and subsequent sensitivity analysis (FR-005) as per the spec's core hypothesis.

FR-005 requires the system to report 'N/A' with a justification if only regression is performed (i.e., if no proxy exists). T028 implements the sensitivity sweep but relies on T027b (classification). If T027b is skipped, T028 is skipped. There is no explicit task to generate the mandatory 'N/A' justification artifact in the final report when the classification model is skipped, risking a failure to satisfy FR-005.

FR-010 requires PGLS or equivalent phylogenetic correction. T024a fetches the tree and halts on failure. T024b implements 'fit_pgl' but the Analyze report flags it as a placeholder. The tasks do not clearly define the failure propagation mechanism to ensure the *entire* pipeline halts if PGLS cannot be performed, risking partial execution without the mandatory phylogenetic correction.

T042 and T051 are marked as '[X]' (completed) in the task list, but the Analyze report flags them as 'REJECTED' due to missing artifacts and incomplete logic. This indicates a stale tag where the task status does not match the actual implementation state, violating the Single Source of Truth principle.

T045 and T046 are marked as '[X]' (completed) but the Analyze report flags them as 'REJECTED' because the required artifacts (vif_heatmap.png, sensitivity_curve.png) are missing. This is a stale tag indicating the task is not actually complete.
